composition.merge_rule: shared frozen Reader features and independent fresh heads; compare stable Top5 from complete 50-score vectors

validation.baseline_equivalence: zero initialized heads exactly reproduce Reader scores and spans are unchanged

reproducibility.dataset_identity: frozen support bundle SHA f723bbb6...; fixed 100-case panel SHA 669ce1...
reproducibility.environment: collaborator Torch/Transformers with pinned DPR Reader; Python >=3.10

producer_owned_lineage: data -> frozenReader -> head -> optimization -> selection -> posthoc
trace_contract.sample_selection_rule: first two training and first two evaluation questions with full hidden sample; first two optimization witnesses per arm and epoch
trace_contract.target_boundary: frozen support targets are used only by training losses; evaluation labels and Silver fields are posthoc after all arms rank

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: new-head/new-loss Top5 retention, direct-support protection, matched classical attribution and complete Reader-span trace

gates.utility: new_quantum_new_loss positive_consensus paired mean > 0 and bootstrap CI95 lower > 0 versus frozen_reader_topk; direct mean >= 0
gates.quantum_attribution: new_quantum_new_loss positive_consensus paired mean > 0 and CI95 lower > 0 versus new_classical_new_loss
gates.stop: kill if utility fails, direct support declines, or any arm violates frozen Reader/span/null/trace integrity

limitations: This is an L0 100-case screen, not a full-data claim.
Exact statevector simulation is classical and establishes no quantum advantage.
The new retention loss is a training surrogate; the online selector remains label-free.
Silver and model-panel judgments remain posthoc diagnostics only.
